market.name: Loudoun Family Market
market.subhead: Nothing in this segment is currently under contract, while every home that has sold has sold successfully — a market that rewards correct entry pricing and punishes everything else.

notes: Both competing homes are on Youngs Cliff Rd itself, both listed at roughly $1.1 million, and both have stalled — 120 and 82 days on market with nothing under contract in the segment. Neither is supported by the comparable sales, which top out at $892,500. They are not competition for a correctly priced home so much as evidence of what happens without a pricing strategy: two neighbours anchored well above the market, sitting.
The three closed sales tell the opposite story — 26, 1 and 9 days on market at or above list. In this segment homes either sell almost immediately or do not sell at all.
